hints.title: Preorder Stream Framing with Null Sentinels
hints.text: A binary tree can be uniquely reconstructed from a single traversal sequence if null child pointers are explicitly marked with sentinel symbols.

hints.title: Recursive Preorder Encoding
hints.text: Traverse root, left child, right child. Emit the node value followed by a delimiter, or emit a sentinel symbol like "N" whenever a null reference is reached.

hints.title: Iterator-Based Tree Reconstruction
hints.text: Split the serialized string by delimiter into a token iterator. For each token, if it equals "N", return None; otherwise construct a node and recursively build left and right subtrees.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in binary tree (0 <= N <= 10^4)
complexity.notes: Visits each node and null pointer exactly once during serialization and deserialization.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Reconstruction from inorder + preorder traversals without null markers fails when node values contain duplicates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Explicit null sentinels allow unique linear tree reconstruction in O(N) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling negative values, empty trees, and recursion depth limits.
